modules.1: Node.js and Express.js Fundamentals Introduction to Backend Development, JavaScript Concepts for Backend Development, Node.js Basics and Development Environment Setup, NPM and Package Management, HTTP Server Setup, HTTP Methods and Status Codes, Handling HTTP Requests and Responses, Express.js Introduction, Routing and Modular Routing, Request and Response Objects, Basic Error Handling.

modules.5: Middleware, Authorization and Error Handling Middleware Functions, Built-in and Custom Middleware, Middleware Execution Flow, Authorization, Role-Based Access Control, Protected Routes, Error Handling, Error Logging, Security Enforcement.

modules.8: MongoDB and Node.js Integration Introduction to MongoDB, MongoDB Installation and Setup, MongoDB Atlas, NoSQL Database Concepts, MongoDB–Node.js Integration, Native MongoDB Driver, Mongoose, Schema Design, Models and Collections, Connecting Backend Applications with MongoDB.
modules.9: MongoDB CRUD APIs and Query Operations MongoDB CRUD Operations, Mongoose Model Methods, Read, Update and Delete Operations, HTTP Status Codes, Query Parameters, Filtering, Case-Insensitive Search, Sorting, Query-Based APIs, API Testing using Postman, Debugging MongoDB APIs.

modules.1: Overview of Computer Organization Functional block diagram of computer, Logic Gates, Boolean Algebra and circuit designing and simplification using k-maps.
modules.2: Combinational and Sequential circuits Combinational Circuits: Half-adder, Full adders, Mux, Demux, Encoder, Decoders, Sequential Circuits: NAND Latch, NOR Latch, SR, JK,D and T flip-flops.
modules.3: Register transfer and micro-operations RTL, register transfer, Bus and memory transfer, Arithmetic microoperations. logical micro - operations, shift micro-operations.
modules.4: Data Representation: Data types and complements, Fixed point and floatin g point representations, Other binary codes, Error detection codes.
modules.5: Arithmetic Algorithms Addition/subtraction of signed magnitude data and signed 2’s complement data, Booth’s multiplication algorithm , Division algorithm. Floating-Point Arithmetic operations.
modules.6: Computer organisation and design Computer registers, Common bus system, computer instructions, Timing and control, Instruction cycle, memory referenced instructions, RISC and CISC systems, input/output interrupt
modules.7: Memory Systems Memory Hierarchy and Characteristics, Cache Memory, Associative mapping, Direct mapping, Set - associative mapping, writing into cache, cache initialization, cache coherence problem, RAID.
modules.8: Input/Output Systems I/O Fundamentals and Devices, Programmed and Interrupt -Driven I/O, Direct Memory Access (DMA), Peripheral Devices and I/O Performance.
modules.9: System Performance Performance Metrics: Throughput, latency, Performance Enhancement Techniques: Parallelism, Caching, Power and Energy Efficiency, Performance Evaluation and Case Studies.
modules.10: Pipelining and Parallel Processing Understanding pipelining and its benefits, Throughput, and Speedup: Measuring performance improvements, Pipeline Hazards: Types and resolution techniques.Parallel Computing Models: Shared memory, distributed memory, Parallel Programming: Threads, processes, and synchronization.

modules.1: Hashing, Sliding Window and Two-Pointer Techniques Hashing – hash tables, hash functions, hash-table operations, collisions, Separate Chaining, Open Addressing, Sliding Window – fixed-size and variable-size windows, window expansion and contraction, Two-Pointer Technique – pointer movement and applications, Maximum Subarray – Kadane’s Algorithm.
modules.2: Linked List Basics Linked Lists – node structure and representation, Singly Linked List – traversal, insertion and deletion, Doubly Linked List – traversal, insertion and deletion, Circular Linked List traversal, insertion and deletion, comparison of linked-list types.
modules.3: Linked List Algorithms Linked List Algorithms – reversal, Floyd’s Cycle-Finding Algorithm, cycle detection and length, adding two numbers, merging two lists, intersection of linked lists, flattening linked lists.
modules.4: Stacks Stacks – ADT and LIFO principle, linked-list implementation, push, pop and peek, infix, prefix and postfix expressions, expression conversion and evaluation, balanced parentheses, Min Stack.
modules.5: Monotonic Stack and Queues Monotonic Stack – increasing and decreasing stacks, Next Greater and Smaller Element, Queues – FIFO principle and linked-list implementation, Stack Using Queue, Queue Using Stack.
modules.6: Binary Trees Binary Trees – tree terminology and representation, types of binary trees, binary tree properties, tree construction and node relationships, Tree Traversals – inorder, preorder, postorder and level-order traversal, Binary Tree Operations – insertion and traversal-based processing.
modules.7: Binary Search Trees Binary Search Trees – definition and ordering property, representation and searching, BST Operations – insertion, deletion and traversal, BST Traversals – inorder, preorder and postorder, BST Views – Top View and Right View, BST Validation – checking and maintaining the BST ordering property.
modules.8: Balanced and Self-Balancing Search Trees Balanced Trees – concept and importance, AVL Trees – structure, balance factor, rotations insertion and deletion, AVL tree balancing, Red-Black Trees – properties, structure, rotations, insertion and deletion, comparison of AVL and Red-Black Trees.
modules.9: Heaps Heaps – heap property and representation, Min-Heap, Max-Heap, heap construction and conversion, insertion and deletion.
modules.10: Priority Queues Priority Queues – ADT and applications, Heap Sort – heap construction and extraction, Priority-Based Processing – applications of priority queues and heap-based problem solving.

modules.1: Foundations of Linear Algebra Introduction to Linear Algebra – importance in Computer Science, Data Science and Machine Learning, real-world applications, Fields and Scalars – definition of a field, field axioms, examples, scalars and vectors, representation of scalars and vectors using Python/NumPy.
modules.2: Vector Spaces, Basis and Dimension Vector Spaces – definition, axioms and examples, linear combinations, subspaces, linear independence, linear span, basis and dimension, implementation of linear independence, computation of basis and dimension using Python/NumPy.
modules.3: Matrices, Determinants and Inverses Matrices – matrix operations and properties, determinants, computation of determinants using expansion and row operations, properties of determinants, matrix inverse, adjoint method, row-reduction method, computation and verification using NumPy.
modules.4: Linear Transformations and Rank-Nullity Linear Transformations – definition and properties, matrix representation of linear transformations, null space and range, dimension of null space, rank and nullity, Rank-Nullity Theorem, implementation of linear transformations using NumPy.
modules.5: Systems of Linear Equations Systems of Linear Equations – homogeneous and non-homogeneous systems, matrix representation, Gauss Elimination Method, Gauss-Jordan Method, solution of linear systems using NumPy, implementation of Gaussian elimination. Numerical Methods for Linear Systems – LU Decomposition, decomposition of matrices, solving linear systems using LU decomposition, Jacobi Iterative Method, Gauss-Seidel Iterative Method, comparison of direct and iterative methods.
modules.6: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors – characteristic equation, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, computation of eigenvalues and eigenvectors, eigenspaces, diagonalization, applications in data analysis and dimensionality reduction, computation and visualization using NumPy.
modules.7: THEORY OF EQUATIONS I — ROOTS & ROOT RELATIONSHIPS Surds and Irrational Roots – Definition and classification of surds – Simplification and rationalization techniques – Handling irrational roots in algebraic equations. Roots in A.P., G.P., and H.P. – Types of roots and Patterns of roots in Arithmetic, Geometric, and Harmonic Progressions – Formulating equations with structured root relationships. Relationship Between Roots and Coefficients – Vieta's formulas – Symmetric functions of roots – Applications in equation analysis.
modules.8: THEORY OF EQUATIONS II — FORMATION & TRANSFORMATION Formation of Equations – Constructing polynomial equations from given roots or conditions – Handling conjugate, reciprocal, and irrational root cases. Root Transformations – Techniques for systematically shifting or scaling roots, – Root transformation methods (Reciprocal Transformation, Negating Roots, Conjugate Root Pairs). Transformation of Equations – Substitution methods – Shifting and scaling of variables – Use in root pattern manipulation.
modules.9: RECIPROCAL EQUATIONS Reciprocal Equations – Definition and recognition – Techniques to solve reciprocal equations Factorization Method, Substitution Method, Graphical Method, Symmetrical Method– Equation modelling. Reciprocal Equations - Implementation – Solving reciprocal equations programmatically – Verifying roots using code.
modules.10: Singular Value Decomposition and Applications Singular Value Decomposition – need for SVD, definition and properties, computation of SVD, relationship between SVD and matrices, dimensionality reduction, image compression, implementation using NumPy.
